messages:
Priya Rao: Hey team — day 1 and hitting a snag. MDM enrollment fails on my personal Ubuntu 22.04 VM (snap errors). Can I get a short personal-device exception while I wait for the corp laptop? Also: when is the mandatory privacy/security training and the phishing sim scheduled? And do we reimburse mobile hotspot data if I buy one?

onboard-bot: Welcome Priya! Please finish the "privacy-bundle" + "security-101" modules in the onboarding portal (https://redwood.co/onboarding). New hires are auto-enrolled in phishsim within 72h. Exception requests should be filed to people-ops@redwood.co with device screenshots.

Maya (People Ops): Hi Priya :wave: You can use a personal device for up to 48 hours for urgent access only. Conditions: full-disk encryption, latest OS patches, dedicated work account, and no local customer data. File an exception request and attach the MDM error screenshot. We typically schedule security training during your first 48 hours; I can slot you for today 4pm PT if that works. Hotspot: we reimburse up to $75 for a temporary purchase — keep the receipt and submit an expense.

Priya Rao: Thanks — sending the MDM error screenshot now. Quick note: the MDM client logs show this: 
```
2023-09-12T09:12:03Z mdm-client[1123]: error: snapd interaction failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = snap install returned 1
2023-09-12T09:12:03Z mdm-client[1123]: hint: try `sudo snap install core`
```
I can try the snap command but wanted to check first so I don't break the VM.

Jordana (Infra): If you run `sudo snap install core` that's safe. If the host is an LXD-backed VM image we have seen snapd timeouts — try: 
```
sudo systemctl restart snapd.service
sudo snap install core --classic
```
If that still fails, reply here and I can spin up a cleared ephemeral dev VM with access for 72 hours. To request the VM email infra-requests@redwood.co and mention thread 2210012345.

Samir (Security): On the exception policy: personal devices >=48h require a signed acknowledgement and video proctoring disabled for any customer data work (i.e., don't store or view PII). We'll auto-enroll you in phishsim; training completion is tracked in the portal. If you fail a simulated phish, you'll receive coaching material and a short retest window. No punitive action for new hires.

Facilities: If you prefer in-person pickup, we have YubiKey/keycards at the SF office front desk after 2pm. Shipping generally takes 2-4 business days. We can also ship a mobile hotspot — coordinate with Maya for expedited shipping.

Priya Rao: 4pm PT for training works for me. I'll try the snap restart and report back. If infra needs to spin up the ephemeral VM please include ssh access instructions and whether I need to request a temporary keypair.

Jordana (Infra): We'll make a short-lived keypair for you if you need the VM — no need to reuse your personal key. If you request the VM, include the hostnames you need and whether you need KMS/HSM access (those require corp device only).

Maya (People Ops): Got your screenshot and marked the exception pending. I've also created an expense template for hotspot reimbursement: https://redwood.co/expenses/forms/hotspot. Tag me if you submit the receipt. See you at 4pm :calendar: 

Priya Rao: Great — restarted snapd and `snap install core` completed. MDM enrollment resumed and finished. Thanks all for the quick responses! See you at training :smile:
